“The first thing worth defending was a circle of people who had decided, against all sense, to defend each other.”

Coalition Tongue (1/a Soma Break). As a bonus action, choose one ally within 30 feet who can hear and understand you. They have reroll the lowest die on the next attack roll, attribute checks [TODO(adv-call)], or defense check they make before the start of your next turn. The fiction matters: name the thing you said, even if it’s wordless.

Symbolic Memory. You can read intent from a place. After spending 10 minutes in any inhabited or formerly-inhabited space, you can ask the GM one of: Who lived here? What did they fear? What did they leave? The answer is at least one truth, even if the GM colours it.
